During the [[Imperial Civil War]], a '''Torpedo Sphere''' was present at [[Chasin]]. During a [[Battle of Chasin|battle]] fought between two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] factions, the [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Sphere]] was destroyed when it was rammed by the [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnought]] [[Javelin (Vengeance-class)|''Javelin'']].
